goals.text: A coding agent in Claude Code or Antigravity extracts a bundle's claims through kmctl verbs, and the main session sees only a short summary
Claims live in one per-project store, in one validated shape that later tickets reuse
A second pass hands out only the sections whose text changed

outcomes.change: Base kmctl holds the claim models, the extraction instructions and a stdlib section cutter with change keys
outcomes.checked_by: `new:tests/test_claims_sections.py` (fixture bundle: section ids, sentence splits, code fences kept whole, correction context, deprecated concepts skipped, keys change with text, title and instructions) and `tests/test_okf_fields.py` still green

outcomes.change: A per-project SQLite store outside the repository, with versioned schema steps
outcomes.checked_by: `new:tests/test_claims_store.py` (path per project and per checkout, `KMCTL_DATA_DIR` override, a fresh and an older-version database both open at the newest version, two writers at once)

outcomes.change: `kmctl claims todo` hands out only new and changed sections, with the instructions
outcomes.checked_by: `new:tests/test_claims_cli.py` (first run lists every section; after submits lists none; an edited section is the only one listed and its old claims are gone; a removed concept's claims are gone; the git tree is unchanged after every verb) and `tests/test_help.py`

outcomes.change: `kmctl claims submit` validates an agent's answer against the claim models and stores it
outcomes.checked_by: `new:tests/test_claims_cli.py` (a valid answer is stored; a stale key, a missing sentence verdict and a malformed answer each refuse with one stderr line naming the fix; good sections in a mixed file are kept)

outcomes.change: `kmctl claims list` shows stored claims per document and kind
outcomes.checked_by: `new:tests/test_claims_cli.py` (counts per kind, one concept's claims, `--kind` filter, `--json` shape)

outcomes.change: An extract-claims skill and a Haiku extractor subagent ship in kmctl's APM package for Claude Code and Antigravity
outcomes.checked_by: `tests/test_apm_package.py` (package and wheel carry the skill and agent), `tests/test_antigravity.py` and `tests/test_opencode.py` (the agent translates), `tests/test_briefing.py::test_briefing_token_budget` (the briefing is 1,866 of 2,000 characters today, so the skill's first sentence must stay short), and a skill test that every `kmctl` command it names exists

outcomes.change: A decision record, the manifesto, the architecture overview and the command reference describe the claims flow
outcomes.checked_by: `kmctl check`, strict OKF validation in the pre-commit hooks, and the docs tests

problems.text: A coding agent in a user's harness cannot extract a bundle's claims: extraction lives only in an untracked prototype that needs langchain and a model key
Nothing stores claims per project or knows which sections changed, so every pass would read the whole bundle while the median bundle commit changes 2 of 38 concepts
No claim schema is enforced on what an agent writes, so agent claims and the later automatic extractor's claims could take different shapes
